thread:
elaine: Quick sync — I'm pulling together a tiny preflight checklist for the week-of-GA sprint. Need fast confirmation on minimal acceptance across SLA, docs, support, monitoring, and pricing. Can we do a rapid triage here?

ton y: tagging owners, thanks. high level: must-have SLA targets, docs checklist, oncall rota, smoke monitors, and pricing guardrails.

jay: from eng side — SLA: 99.9% for hosted API latency P95 < 250ms for small payloads. Need infra signoff on burst capacity.

beth: docs: basic quickstart, SDK snippets (py/js), and "troubleshooting" + rollback guidance. I can own quickstart and troubleshooting.

maria: support: Level 1 playbook + escalation path to SEs + devex on-call for first week. Do we need a dedicated pager rotation?

elaine: good — aim: no dedicated pager day-0 unless major. L1 handles tickets; escalation to oncall SRE for infra incidents. Beth/maria coordinate.

tony: monitoring: we need three smoke checks: 1) model endpoint success rate, 2) queue latency, 3) token cost per minute anomaly. Alerts to #prod-alerts + page at severity >= P1. Can SRE own these?

simon: will add the alerts. For cost anomaly we need a feed from billing side — can finance emit a usage metric?

maria: finance can push a delta metric; I'll loop in sara-finance. Also recommend a soft kill switch if cost spikes > 3x baseline in 15min window.

jay: on burst capacity — capacity fallback plan: if Dedicated pool saturates, route to cheaper quantized model variant for background traffic. Need routing policy documented.

elaine: add routing fallback doc. We should list pinned model versions and fallback variants in the rollout doc.

beth: docs checklist: (a) Quickstart, (b) SDK examples, (c) Rollback + routing fallback, (d) SLA and SLO summary page, (e) Support playbook. I'll draft and share a PR by EOD tomorrow.

tony: pricing: propose guardrail: public hosted GA price = baseline + surge floor; set quota defaults for new accounts (tokens/day) and a billing backstop for first 30 days. @maria will run gap with billing team.

maria: I can own quota defaults and billing emergency contact. Will confirm backstop wording by EOD.

elaine: owners confirmed: SLA & routing: jay + simon, Docs: beth, Support & quotas: maria, Monitoring & alerts: simon + sre-bot, Pricing guardrail: tony + maria.

beth: quick question — do we want a one-pager for customer-facing launch notes vs internal runbook?

simon: yes. One-pager customer-facing (what to expect, limits, support path). Separate internal runbook with pager steps + debug commands.

jay: can eng provide smoke script snippet for runbook? I'll push a gist and link.

elaine: perfect. Can everyone drop a short bullet in the shared doc by 5pm today? I'll consolidate and we can finalize in tomorrow's standup. If any blocker — flag now.

tony: no blockers from pricing.

maria: looping sara-finance now.

sre-bot: [automation] created alert ticket #ALRT-4521 for model endpoint success rate.

beth: acked, will start the PR.

elaine: thanks all — short, targeted, ship-ready checklist incoming. :thumbsup:
